description: Resolves a reporter citation "<volume> <reporter> <page>" (e.g. 347 U.S. 483) to the matching case cluster(s) in the local mirror, optionally with member opinions and parallel citations. A 404 means the citation is not in this mirror, not that the case does not exist. A resolved citation shows the case is in the mirror; it is not a good-law, treatment or validity signal. One citation can sit on several records: all are returned up to 25, and capped=true means more records carry it than are shown. Every response carries a "note" stating that response’s source and coverage limits. A miss carries one too.

include.description: extra data to attach: "opinions" (member opinions), "citations" (parallel cites)

name: citation
title: Resolve a reporter citation
